question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf0cf8e2a9da8fd57f3640e4f13f4ef988fe9d6e1d3d390478c09ae8f20a5f2b.png]
solution:
Here, we can see that the given figure is moving in clockwise direction.

Given: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eaf8db29e8e78c29f62fa38a01f6855ac85eb04f705dd3f5411c7b85bb3ef83.png] 

In the 1st figure the arrow is bottom left facing left, next it is at top left facing top.

Similarly seeing this, the missing image will be same as the 1st figure given.

First, we will check all the options:

We see that, the next figure will have the arrow at the bottom left and so option 4 is eliminated.

Next, we see that the rectangle image will be in horizontal direction and so option 3 is eliminated.

Again, we see that, the black part is on top and so option 1 is eliminated.

Thus, we are left with option 2 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7614dab0498537e3f87a62faf1cc696e20ef9d58f6d135169c97448d25aa799f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is __**option 2**__.
